newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Persetel takes control of German firm.
newsitem.headline: Persetel takes control of German firm.

text.p: Persetel Holdings Ltd said on Monday it was to buy a 70 percent controlling stake in German company Telemation AG for an undisclosed sum.
This will bring the South African information technology group closer to its goal of lifting offshore earnings to 60 percent by the turn of the century, Business Day newspaper said.
The "multibillion-rand" deal will be financed through the issue of 70-million Persetel shares.
It would see the South African company gaining control of the largest independent integrator of Cisco networking products in Europe, the paper said.
Cisko is the world's leading manufacturer of networking products and had sales worth about $4.7 billion last year.
The two companies said that holders of more than 50 percent of Telemation's equity had undertaken to vote in favour of the deal which would be funded by the issue of new Persetel shares.

The South African company would hold 70 percent while Telemation's management would be given an option to double its shareholding to 20 percent. The balance would be held by the founder of the company who would retain ten percent.
